steps.text: Inspect the empty display case in the north-east corner of the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis to start the quest
Talk to Curator Herminius in the middle of the museum. Talk about the empty display case
chat: 4. Could you tell me more about that empty display?

steps.text: Investigate the tools behind the display case.
Talk to the citizens, academics, and tourists around the room about their suspicions until one mentions a mysterious individual.
Talk to Regulus Cento by the quetzals south-west of the museum
chat: 2. Have you seen anybody suspicious around?

steps.text: Go east and talk to a Trader Crewmember (charter ship crewmember) about the suspicious man (1 inventory space required)
chat: 4. Have you seen a man with a case?
1. As long as it is just the one favour...

steps.text: Go to the crafting shop south-east and get the sail repaired by Artima
chat: 2. I was hoping for some help.

steps.text: Go back to the Trader Crewmember and talk about the suspicious man again
chat: 4. So, about that man with the case

steps.text: Head to Port Sarim, then talk to Trader Stan or any of the Trader Crewmembers who are located at the most south dock
chat: 4. Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?

steps.text: Talk to Betty in the runeshop in north-west Port Sarim
chat: 2. Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?

steps.text: Talk to Curator Haig Halen in Varrock Museum about Xerna's Diadem - Option 2 if Bone Voyage is complete
Pickpocket him for the storeroom key.
Open the storeroom in the north-east part of the museum and search the crates.
Go back and talk to Haig Halen selecting option 1 to begin the scene - Option 2 if Bone Voyage is complete
Select options that will shame Haig Halen. A full list of which options to select can be found in the in-depth guide.
Return to the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis and talk to Curator Herminius to complete the quest
